We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an Applied AI Engineer in Berlin, you’ll build the production AI systems behind Resonance’s client engagements across DACH, driving a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier alongside Senior AI Engineers, owning features, integrations and evals end to end. You’ll build and ship agentic systems, from agents and MCP servers into client systems to retrieval and the product around them, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll build evals and observability from day one, take features from first prototype to production, and deploy and extend what we build inside client environments, shipping at pace with the latest AI coding tools. You’ll grow with the firm by contributing to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning what you learn on each build into reusable components, and taking on more ownership as you grow.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have up to four years building software at a startup, a scale-up, a fast-moving product team or your own company. You write production Python or TypeScript, have shipped software with an LLM at its core, at work or on your own projects, and have iterated on prompts, agent loops and evals. You’re at home with messy real-world data, APIs and SQL, you ship fast without cutting corners, and you enjoy solving problems with technical and non-technical people. You have consistently been among the top performers in high-performing environments, at university or at work. Forward deployed experience, AI side projects or a company you founded are a plus, and so is German for client work in DACH.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Most engineers get one shot at a startup. Here you build many products, not one: our own AI products and platform, and several production AI systems a year across industries. You’ll learn fast alongside people who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, with scope that grows as fast as your impact. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm. As one of our first engineers in Berlin, you’ll shape how we build, operate and grow.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Send your CV, your GitHub profile and a short note on the AI system you're proudest of shipping and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

description:
About Virtual Identity

 

Virtual Identity (VI) is a digital agency built on Human-Centered Business Growth: combining empathy for people with insight from data to drive real digital success. With around 140 colleagues across Freiburg, Munich, Vienna, and Porto (and remote), we cover the full spectrum from Consulting and UX Research to UX/UI Design, Software Development, and Digital Marketing — always learning in close collaboration with our clients.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at VI, you sit at the intersection of client, product, and engineering. You're not building in isolation from a backlog handed down by someone else — you go into deep, sustained virtual immersion with the client, understand their real operational problems, and ship working software that solves them, fast. You prototype, integrate, and iterate directly with the people who will use what you build, then help harden it into something production-ready with our delivery teams.

You also bring a well-founded understanding of agentic engineering — not just using AI coding assistants, but genuinely understanding how agents plan, use tools, and fail, and applying that thinking to how you build, integrate, and automate in the field.

This role suits someone who's equally comfortable in a client workshop, a codebase, and a data pipeline — and who gets energy from ambiguity rather than needing it resolved before starting.

 

What you will do:

  • Embed with client teams to observe workflows, diagnose bottlenecks, and identify where custom software can create outsized impact.

  • Rapidly prototype and deploy solutions — internal tools, integrations, automations, data pipelines — directly in the client's environment.

  • Translate messy, real-world requirements into working code without waiting for a fully specified brief.

  • Own the full loop: build, deploy, get feedback from actual users within days, iterate.

  • Use agentic engineering practices — not just AI-assisted coding, but designing workflows, automations, and integrations that leverage agents as a core part of the solution, where it genuinely helps the client.

  • Work closely with VI's UX, consulting, and cloud-native engineering teams to transition prototypes into scalable, supportable production systems.

  • Navigate client infrastructure, security constraints, and existing systems (cloud platforms, APIs, legacy tools) pragmatically.

  • Act as a trusted technical voice in client conversations — you can whiteboard an architecture and defend it in the same meeting.

  • Travel to client sites as needed (frequency depends on engagement).

    What we expect:

  • Strong full-stack or cloud-native engineering experience, with a track record of shipping real software, not just prototypes that die in a demo.

  • Comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders and translating their problems into technical solutions on the fly.

  • Solid grounding in at least one modern backend stack and one frontend stack, plus working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with APIs, data integration, and automation — you can connect systems that were never designed to talk to each other.

  • Real, well-founded knowledge of agentic engineering — you understand the underlying concepts (agent planning, tool use, context management, orchestration, evaluation), not just the tool names, and you've applied that thinking to real work, not side projects.

  • A bias toward action: you'd rather build a rough version and test it with real users than perfect a spec.

  • Strong communication skills — you can explain a technical trade-off to a client stakeholder without jargon.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; forward deployed work is inherently unstructured.

  • Willingness to travel to client sites.

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or client-facing technical role (nice to have).

  • Familiarity with UX research or design collaboration workflows (nice to have).

  • Exposure to enterprise integration patterns or legacy system modernization (nice to have).

  • Hands-on experience building or deploying agentic systems for a client, not just personal productivity use (nice to have).

  • A relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — but we care more about what you've built (nice to have).

What you can expect from us

 

Exciting projects with well-known brands, a team of motivated colleagues who genuinely enjoy working together, and continuous learning through our VI Academy. Whether you're based in one of our offices or working fully remote, we give you the room to grow — professionally and personally.

title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials.

  • Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations.

  • Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure.

  • Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment.

  • Provide material property data and guidance on material-driven design features to the Mechanical Design team.

  • Support material choices for thermal adhesives, gap fillers, electrical bonding, and insulation together with the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, and Airborne Electronics teams.

  • Draft test requests (TRQs) for material characterization and work with the test team and suppliers to execute them.

  • Analyse test data and derive design-relevant material properties and conclusions.

  • Own technical relationships with material suppliers, including requirements alignment, data requests, and the evaluation of new material candidates.

  • Define material specifications and approved-material definitions together with Materials & Processes.

  • Contribute to material qualification and certification substantiation, transferring ownership to Materials & Processes as development matures.

  • Assess material compatibility and durability over the service life, including chemical compatibility with coolants and electrolytes, galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, moisture uptake, outgassing, and property retention after thermal cycling and accelerated aging, as well as resistance to thermal runaway vent gases and ejecta, working with the Materials & Processes Engineer where processing such as cure state or surface preparation affects the result.

  • Lead failure investigations and root cause analyses where material behaviour is a contributor.

  • Consider regulatory constraints such as REACH and RoHS in material selection.

  • Act as the technical authority on materials in design reviews and technical discussions with suppliers and partners.

  • Mentor engineers and build materials expertise across the Technology division.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science & Engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in materials engineering, preferably in aerospace, battery systems, or other safety-critical industries.

  • Deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships in polymers, composites, metals, and ceramics.

  • Proven ability to select the best material for a given application, based on data and first principles.

  • Experience with material characterization methods such as mechanical testing, DSC, TGA, DMA, cone calorimetry, and microscopy.

  • Experience planning tests, interpreting results, and correlating them with design requirements.

  • Strong knowledge of thermoset and thermoplastic composites, adhesives, and elastomers.

  • Knowledge of high-temperature material performance and fire, smoke, and toxicity behaviour is desirable.

  • Experience leading technical work with material suppliers.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, and CMH-17 is beneficial.

  • Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. German is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

description:
Your Mission:

You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

At Lightspeed, smooth operations and proactive execution drive our commercial success. As a Senior Sales Coordinator, you are the strategic operational backbone of the Account Management (AM) team. Beyond basic coordination, you will drive operational excellence, safeguard high-value strategic key accounts, and relieve management of high-friction administrative obstacles.

You will act as a critical cross-functional hub - taking full end-to-end ownership of complex account workflows, streamlining standardized processes across the department, and enabling the wider AM team to focus on revenue-generating opportunities and key client relationships.

***Please note that we operate a hybrid working model, which requires you to work from the office three days per week.***

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Account Operational Ownership: Take complete end-to-end operational responsibility for critical major client accounts, coordinating complex hardware processes, international account interfaces, and location expansion rollouts seamlessly.

  • Management Shielding & Escalation Resolution: Proactively intercept, investigate, and independently solve complex account discrepancies (e.g., pricing errors, manual compensation, full returns) to shield management resources and protect strategic leadership bandwidth.

  • Cross-Functional Team Support: Serve as the centralized subject matter expert for high-friction operational procedures - such as complete end-to-end Contract Transfers across product lines - absorbing these time-intensive workflows to free up capacity for the broader Account Management team.

  • Process Standardization & Optimization: Identify operational bottlenecks in key account workflows, establish structured review routines, and implement standardized procedures to ensure long-term consistency and error-free execution.

  • Interdepartmental Interface: Partner closely with Go-To-Market (GTM) Operations, technical support, and international teams to ensure swift, accurate transaction execution and flawless new location openings.

  • Milestone & Project Alignment: Drive strategic project milestones and maintain high-level communication channels on major enterprise projects, minimizing routine admin clutter in favor of strategic impact.

What You Need to Bring

  • Proven Operational Track Record: Solid experience in a senior administrative, sales operations, or account coordination role - ideally within a fast-paced SaaS or tech environment.

  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to independently own complex, high-stakes tasks end-to-end without requiring day-to-day managerial supervision.

  • Analytical Problem-Solving: Advanced capability to untangle complex system errors, audit manual discrepancies, and establish sustainable standardized workflows.

  • Strong Interpersonal & Stakeholder Management Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both German and English.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Ability to act as a supportive reference point for peer Account Managers, taking on heavy operational lifting to elevate overall department performance.

  • Education & Business Acumen: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

What's in It for You

  • Work from Anywhere: Work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 60 days per year.

  • Modern Ways of Working: A hybrid working model offering flexibility.

  • Stock Options: Participate in the Lightspeed Stock Option Program.

  • €400 Health & Wellness Budget: Supporting your physical and mental well-being.

  • Mental Health Support: Access to mental health resources through the Modern Health app.

  • Impact-Driven Environment: Join an agile team with a global vision.

Ready to scale impact in B2B SaaS?

Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Du arbeitest je nach Projekt mit unterschiedlichen Technologien: JavaScript und TypeScript im Frontend, PHP und Laravel, Node.js oder Python im Backend. Gemeinsam mit dem Team wählst du die passende Lösung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Webanwendungen vom Frontend bis zum Backend und begleitest sie bis zum produktiven Betrieb.

  • Du baust verständliche Benutzeroberflächen mit React, Next.js, Vue.js oder vergleichbaren Frameworks.

  • Du bindest bestehende Kunden-, ERP- und Drittsysteme an und sorgst für einen zuverlässigen Datenaustausch.

  • Du entwirfst Datenmodelle und setzt Geschäftslogik, Benutzerverwaltung, Rollen und Berechtigungen sauber um.

  • Du integrierst KI-Funktionen und automatisierte Workflows in unsere Anwendungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren KI- und Automatisierungsentwicklern zusammen.

  • Du stimmst technische Anforderungen mit der Projektleitung ab und machst frühzeitig sichtbar, wenn etwas unklar ist oder aufwendiger wird.

  • Du dokumentierst wichtige technische Entscheidungen so, dass andere im Team deine Arbeit nachvollziehen und weiterführen können.

Das bringst du mit

  • Praktische Erfahrung darin, Webanwendungen eigenständig vom Frontend bis zum Backend zu entwickeln und produktiv einzusetzen.

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript und TypeScript sowie Erfahrung mit React, Next.js, Vue.js oder einem vergleichbaren Frontend-Framework.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in PHP und praktische Erfahrung mit Laravel.

  • Erfahrung mit Node.js oder Python, idealerweise mit einem Backend-Framework wie Express, NestJS oder FastAPI.

Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection.

We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly.

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen.

  • 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – bei SME sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zur führenden Finanzplattform geworden.

  • 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft.

Deine Mission

Du wirst Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – SME in Deutschland sein und unser neu geschaffenes SME-Team von Grund auf aufbauen. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives SME in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team auf.

In Frankreich nutzen über 900.000 SME Pennylane. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales, an den du berichtest, an den deutschen SME-Markt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Head of Sales, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Managing Director in Berlin.

Dein Team

Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer SME-Kunden.

Im Ausbau: In den kommenden Monaten könnten wir ein eigenes Team für Onboarding und Account Management aufbauen – du gestaltest mit, wie Neukundengewinnung, Onboarding und Bestandskundenbetreuung zusammenspielen, damit deine AEs ihre Zeit wirksam einsetzen.

Regional organisiert: Jede:r Account Executive ist für mehrere Regionen verantwortlich, die von Berlin aus betreut werden – per Inside Sales und Video-Demo, bei wichtigen Kunden auch vor Ort. Rechne mit etwa zehn Reisen pro Jahr in die jeweiligen Regionen.

Im Aufbau: In Deutschland sind bereits zwei Account Executives an Bord, ab Januar kommt ein SDR für die Lead-Qualifizierung dazu. Das Team soll weiter ausgebaut werden: Du stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere AEs ein, arbeitest sie ein und führst sie zum Erfolg – das Team wächst mit dir.

Schneller Vertrieb: Klassischer SMB-Sales: Dein Team gewinnt Unternehmer:innen und Finanzverantwortliche in SME – kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Schlagzahl, überzeugende Demos. Ihr zeigt konkret, wie Pennylane den Finanzalltag eines Unternehmens vereinfacht.

Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Präsenz ist Teil deiner Führung: Du coachst deine AEs im Office Seite an Seite und begleitest sie bei wichtigen Kunden vor Ort – etwa zehn Reisen pro Jahr in die Regionen deines Teams.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams – gemessen am MRR aus deutschen SME – und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum im deutschen SME-Markt.

  • Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für SME weiter (Inside Sales, Demos, Onboarding) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

  • Du baust die Prozesse deines Teams auf – vom Sales-Playbook über Forecasting bis zur Pipeline-Steuerung.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – SME sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – mit einem Aktivitätsniveau, das die individuellen und gemeinsamen Ziele erreichbar macht.

  • Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

  • Du bringst die Perspektive des SME-Vertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – per Video-Call oder vor Ort beim Kunden.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung als Account Executive im B2B-SaaS-Sales mit – idealerweise im SMB-Segment mit kurzen Deal-Zyklen und hoher Schlagzahl – und hast mindestens zwei Jahre ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst das Fintech- oder B2B-SaaS-Ökosystem – oder hast an Unternehmer:innen und Finanzverantwortliche in SME verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

  • Du besitzt ein unternehmerisches Mindset, fühlst dich in einem noch nicht vollständig strukturierten Umfeld wohl und hast Lust, Dinge von Grund auf aufzubauen.

  • Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

  • Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – und hast weiterhin Lust, selbst zu verkaufen, um den Markt zu kennen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Unternehmer:innen – und sicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern vor Ort: zwei Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office und rund zehn Reisen pro Jahr zu AEs und Kunden in den Regionen.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

title: GTM Lead, APAC
description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role

Higgsfield AI is looking for a GTM Lead, APAC to build and own our commercial business across Asia-Pacific (excluding Japan, which has its own dedicated lead). APAC is already one of our largest regions by creators and generations; this role turns that usage into agency, brand and enterprise revenue.

You will define the APAC go-to-market, source and close the region's first lighthouse accounts yourself, open the partner routes to market that matter in Asia, and set the playbook that the next wave of APAC hires will follow. You will work closely with our Asia-based Growth team, our US-based Enterprise team, and directly with company leadership.

The ideal candidate has sold creative, marketing or AI technology across at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures, knows when a partner is the right route in and when direct is, and is energised by owning a region from zero.

What you'll do

Open the APAC market

  • Build and execute Higgsfield's APAC go-to-market strategy, tiered by market: active selling in Singapore, Australia and New Zealand, Korea and Hong Kong; relationship building in Southeast Asia, India and Taiwan; later investment elsewhere.

  • Segment the region by readiness to buy: advertising and creative agencies, consumer brands, production companies, broadcasters and streamers, K-content, gaming and sports media.

  • Personally source, run and close the region's first enterprise and agency deals, from first touch through negotiation and signature, adapting to how each market buys: procurement-led in ANZ, relationship-first in Korea and Greater China, partner-led and price-sensitive in Southeast Asia and India.

  • Convert high-usage APAC creators, teams and agencies already on the platform into team and enterprise accounts.

Build pipeline and revenue

  • Own APAC pipeline, forecast and bookings; keep 3x+ pipeline coverage and report weekly to leadership.

  • Run an outbound-first motion in markets where inbound is thin, alongside platform-driven inbound where it is strong: executive outreach, events, partner introductions and creator-community referrals.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, enterprise agreements, and multi-year, usage-based and local-currency deal structures.

  • Build regional references and case studies that make the next APAC deal easier than the last.

Work the ecosystem

  • Build relationships with senior decision-makers at regional agency holding-company offices, independent agencies, consumer brands and media groups.

  • Identify and activate the partners that are the primary route to market in Asia (regional agency networks, telcos and platforms, production studios, system integrators, local resellers) with the Head of Partnerships.

  • Represent Higgsfield at APAC industry events and in regional media as the leading AI video platform for creative work.

  • Localise positioning, pricing packaging and campaigns for APAC buyers with Marketing and Product, and coordinate with our existing APAC content and community efforts.

  • Surface market, competitive, platform and regulatory signals from the region to Product, Legal and leadership.

  • Define what the APAC team should look like at 5 and 15 people, and help hire it.

What success looks like in year one

  • A tiered APAC market plan and sales playbook that leadership has signed off.

  • Marquee customers live in production in at least two active-selling markets, with public references.

  • Two or more partner channels producing qualified pipeline.

  • A forecast that is accurate within 15% quarter over quarter.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in enterprise sales, business development, partnerships or GTM leadership, including 3+ years selling SaaS, AI, creative technology, marketing technology or media technology in APAC.

  • A track record of sourcing and closing six- and seven-figure deals yourself, not only through a team.

  • Multi-country APAC experience: you have sold or led commercial efforts in at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures.

  • Partner and channel experience in APAC markets where partners are the primary route to market.

  • An existing network of senior buyers in APAC agencies, brands, media or entertainment companies.

  • Comfortable opening a region alone and far from HQ: no local marketing, SE or RevOps bench on day one, and independent decision-making across time zones.

  • Fluent English; Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, Bahasa or Thai is a strong plus.

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Almaty; or based in Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong or Korea with the right to work there and able to travel across the region and to Almaty regularly.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for generative AI and hands-on fluency with Higgsfield or comparable creative AI tools.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an AI-native company, a creator platform, a social or short-video platform, or a usage-based software business.

  • Relationships in K-content, gaming, or broadcaster and streamer ecosystems in Asia.

  • Prior experience as a first or founding commercial hire in a region.

What we're not looking for

  • A strategy-only leader who needs a team before they can produce results.

  • Someone whose success has depended on a large inbound brand and a full supporting bench.

  • A single-market seller; APAC is too diverse for one-country experience.

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

  • Equity participation through the company's stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield's long-term growth.

  • Relocation support for candidates moving from another city or country.

  • A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

  • Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

Location and working model

We would prefer this person to be based in Almaty, where much of our Growth team sits and which keeps workable overlap with every APAC time zone. We are equally happy with a fully remote hire based in Singapore, Sydney, Hong Kong or Seoul, with regular travel to customers across the region and to Almaty and San Francisco for planning sessions and company events. Team members are expected to maintain sufficient overlap with the Growth team's working hours and to be active, responsive and close collaborators across time zones.

description:
Wir sind das Rückgrat einiger Non-Profit-Organisationen in Berlin. Wir bauen verlässliche und sichere IT-Lösungen, damit sich Vereine, Stiftungen und NGOs auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können: ihre Mission. Bei uns baust du IT, die trägt – statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.

Unsere Kund:innen sind Organisationen wie das Deutsche Kinderhilfswerk, die Technologiestiftung Berlin oder die Weltbank Group – Menschen, die mit ihrer Arbeit etwas verändern. Und du sorgst dafür, dass ihre IT verlässlich funktioniert.

Deine Rolle

Du bist bei uns die Person für Microsoft 365 und Intune. Du entscheidest, wie ein Tenant aufgesetzt ist, welche Richtlinien für Konten und Geräte gelten und wie die Daten vom alten Fileserver sauber in SharePoint landen. Bevor bei Kund:innen etwas umgebaut wird, planst du es – von der Bestandsaufnahme über das Zielbild bis zum Cut-over – und setzt es anschließend mit dem Team um. Was du bei uns machst

Microsoft 365 & Entra ID

  • Tenants aufsetzen und aufräumen: Rollen, Lizenzen, Gruppen, Gastzugriffe und klare Namenskonventionen

  • Exchange Online betreuen: Postfächer, Verteiler, Mail-Flow, Spam- und Phishing-Schutz, SPF, DKIM und DMARC

  • SharePoint und Teams so strukturieren, dass Seiten, Bibliotheken und Berechtigungen auch in zwei Jahren noch verständlich sind

Intune & Endgeräte

  • Windows-Geräte über Intune verwalten: Konfigurations- und Compliance-Richtlinien, Updates und App-Rollouts

  • Microsoft Defender for Business einrichten und Meldungen bewerten

  • Apple-Geräte einbinden, wo Kund:innen gemischt arbeiten, über Intune und Apple Business Manager

Migrationen & Projekte

  • Bestandsaufnahmen bei Kund:innen durchführen und daraus ein Zielbild entwickeln: Wo soll die IT in ein bis zwei Jahren stehen?

  • Umzüge planen und umsetzen: vom Fileserver nach SharePoint, von Google Workspace zu Microsoft 365, von Tenant zu Tenant oder raus aus dem lokalen Active Directory

  • Den Plan selbst mit umsetzen: Testlauf, Cut-over am Wochenende, Rückfallebene und Nachbetreuung der Nutzer:innen

  • Konzepte so aufschreiben, dass Geschäftsführung und Vorstand entscheiden können: mit Varianten, Kosten und Risiken

  • Aufwände realistisch schätzen und Angebote gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung vorbereiten

Copilot, KI & Automatisierung

Support & Schulung

title: Lead Database Administrator
description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans. 
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team! 

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay) 
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is on a mission to power the connected operations that keep the world moving. As our Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter in EMEA, you will lead Engineering Early Talent (New Grads and Interns) and G&A hiring across multiple businesses. You will partner with regional and global leaders, build sourcing strategies that work, and give every candidate a standout experience.

You should apply if these excite you:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work helps keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores and workers home safely, as we digitize large sectors of the global economy.
  • High-Impact Role: Direct visibility and influence with regional and global business leaders in a fast-growing organisation.
  • You are the architect of your own career: Put in the work and this role won't be your last at Samsara, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together and support each other, surrounded by a high-calibre team that pushes you to do your best.
  • Cutting-Edge Tools: Work with best-in-class, AI-forward recruiting technologies and data-driven strategies.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead G&A hiring across EMEA: partner with a very diverse group of business leaders, plan hiring by function (Finance, People, Legal, IT), and switch context fast to keep every business moving.
  • Build our Early Talent programs in EMEA: lead local New Grad and Intern hiring, grow university relations and campus pipelines, and work with HQ on planning and execution and with local engineering leaders to hire early-career talent who meet our high bar.
  • Build creative sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, referrals and other channels, tailored to each function and market and backed by EMEA market intelligence.
  • Manage the pipeline from sourcing to onboarding, with an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Use data to refine recruiting strategy and influence hiring decisions.
  • Champion diversity, equity and inclusion through impactful hiring programs.
  • Work with People, Legal, Finance and Mobility to streamline hiring, including country-specific requirements.
  • Mentor peers and foster a culture of learning in the recruitment team.
  • Embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • You have 6+ years of proven full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in a tech organisation with a very high hiring bar.
  • You have proven experience building Early Talent programs, hiring for Engineering New Grads and Interns in UK (mandatory) and G&A roles (e.g. Finance, People, Legal, IT) in EMEA.
  • You communicate with key partners in a concise, professional and pro-active way.
  • You have exceptional stakeholder management abilities and executive presence, experienced working with a very diverse population of business leaders and switching context rapidly and comfortably.
  • Innovation mindset: you're comfortable implementing new tools, technologies, and methodologies.
  • AI - forward: we would like to see strong analytical skills when looking into hiring data and forecasting hiring needs. 
  • Optimising the use of the AI tools available to create a better candidate experience and efficient workflows. No AI slop.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Deep understanding of EMEA talent market trends, turned into actionable strategies for each function.
  • Proven outbound sourcing for technical and specialist talent in a competitive market.

What's in it for you?

  • The chance to shape and build Samsara's teams across EMEA.
  • A high-visibility role: build connections and influence with Samsara's regional & global business leaders.
  • A passionate, innovative & AI-Forward team committed to excellence

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Commercial Marketing (Restaurants)
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Deliveroo connects millions of consumers with the restaurants and brands they love. Our Integrated Marketing team sits at the heart of how we bring those relationships to life — combining customer insight, commercial opportunity and creativity to drive growth for Deliveroo and our partners.

Within Central Integrated Marketing, the Merchant & Ads team sets the global strategy for how we partner with merchants to help them grow on our marketplace and create compelling reasons for consumers to choose Deliveroo. This is an opportunity to shape Deliveroo's global approach to restaurant partnerships, building high-impact collaborations with some of the world's most recognised and loved restaurant brands. This will be a hybrid role - working 3 days a week from our London HQ.

About the role

  • Owns the Restaurants merchant and ads marketing strategy end to end, reporting into the Merchant & Ads IM Director.

  • Responsible for the creation and deployment of Restaurant merchant marketing playbooks across co marketing, promotions, and ads.

  • Responsible for the creation and deployment of the Restaurant sell in strategy and associated sell in materials for adoption by local teams.

  • Supports local marketing teams with key enterprise merchant relationships at the global level, and supports priority restaurant marketing initiatives.

What you'll be doing

Ads & Monetization Strategy

  • Own the Restaurants specific ads and monetization strategy across owned and external surfaces, feeding into the global monetization strategy.

  • Determine pricing, packaging, and commercial models for category-wide advertising in close partnership with Finance.

Category Playbook: Restaurants

  • Own and evolve the Restaurants merchant marketing playbook, setting how co marketing, promotions, and advertising work for restaurant merchants globally.

  • Lead change initiatives that improve how Restaurants merchant marketing works, bringing Local Integrated Marketing and Functional Marketing along with you.

Key Merchant Relationship Management

  • Support local marketing teams with key enterprise merchant relationships at the global level, and support delivery of priority restaurant marketing initiatives with those merchants.

  • Resolve critical merchant issues as the primary executive escalation point across markets and functional groups.

Cross Functional Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to Merchant S&O and Commercial for Restaurants, translating category priorities into marketing and ads strategy.

  • Represent Restaurants in cross functional forums, shaping the roadmap for merchant facing and ads facing surfaces.

Sell In Strategy & Sales Enablement

  • Establish high-impact sell-in strategies and pitch frameworks to enable Commercial and Local teams globally.

  • Oversee the sell in materials, case studies, and proof points for Restaurants, using performance data to continuously refine them.

The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch, and we’re now looking for a driven Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.

If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex financial challenges and you excel in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we want to hear from you.

  • Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders without corporate red tape, , you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.

You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.

  • Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.

  • Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship

Your Background

  • Experience: +3 years of commercial software engineering experience, ideally with experience building or maintaining distributed systems or backend APIs.

  • Hands-on Coder: You are a strong practitioner who loves shipping clean, readable code and takes pride in seeing features go live.

  • Tech Stack Proficiency: Proficient in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go) and comfortable working within cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Pragmatic Mindset: You understand the balance between elegant code and delivering real value to users in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Curious & First-Principles Thinker: You enjoy dissecting how systems work under the hood and are ready to quickly pick up domain concepts like options pricing, execution mechanics, and financial regulations.

On-call

All engineers at Investa participate in supporting our production applications. This involves responding to critical system events outside of working hours and ensuring our platform stays dependable.

What we offer:

Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.

Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.

The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

Compensation and Benefits

Financial Growth 💸

  • Base Salary: £60,000 - £85,000 per annum, commensurate with experience.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by you. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

You will lead the design and implementation of automated, platform-based security solutions, enabling teams to build secure software while maintaining velocity. You will partner closely with Core Tech, Product, and Engineering leadership to define our security roadmap and culture.

We’re excited about you because you are a trailblazer who balances high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution. You are comfortable building from near-scratch, thrive on educating others, and possess a "platform" mindset that prioritizes empowering developers over acting as a gatekeeper.

  • Develop and maintain platform-level security tools that enable automated, self-service security for feature teams.

  • Partner with Core Tech to integrate security primitives into our standard CI/CD and cloud deployment workflows.

  • Conduct cross-team discovery to assess current security posture and identify high-risk technical debt.

  • Mentor junior and peer engineers, fostering a culture where security is integrated into the "you build it, you run it" philosophy.

title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
description:

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Our Mission:

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport .

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

 

About the role

  • Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked.

  • The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet.

  • A small team that ships fast. We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user.

 

What you’ll do

  • Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on

  • Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying

  • Engineer how we feed context to AI models: how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention

  • Evolve our workflow builder: something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections

  • Design the architecture behind the product: how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful.

 

Who you are

  • You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath.

  • You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges.

  • You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t.

  • You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states.

  • You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API.

 

Interview process

  • An initial call with our talent team.

  • A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python.

  • An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO).

  • Onsite Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here.

  • Offer!

 

Compensation and benefits

We’re in the office five days a week, so we’ve made it a great place to be.

  • £120k–£150k base + significant equity, so you have a real stake in what you’re building

  • 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays, which you can take at your discretion.)

  • Bupa private medical: £0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered, digital GP, plus Bupa dental

  • Fresh meal prep delivered every week, a stocked fridge, and team lunch out every Friday

  • Working late? Dinner’s on us, and so is your Uber home

  • Full visa sponsorship

  • New MacBook and whatever tools you need

  • Flexible parental leave, including adoption leave

  • Regular team events and off-sites

Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite.

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables.

Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.

Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.

Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.

L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.

Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

• Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle
• Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie
• Bonnes compétences en programmation

Capacités et aptitudes :
