title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment as part of our application or assessment process, please let us know by emailing View email address on apply.workable.com

title: Global Senior Program Manager
description:
Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations. 

 

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. 

 

Your main responsibilities are: 

  • Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery. 

  • Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites. 

  • Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle. 

  • Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables. 

  • Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production. 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact. 

  • Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together. 

 

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth. 

 

Why do you want this position? 

Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. 

 

What do we offer? 

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is rewarded, and where you have the opportunity to turn your ideas into reality. We offer a dynamic environment with plenty of room to grow, take ownership, and advance your career. You will be part of a global company while still enjoying the down-to-earth culture that Twente is known for. 

At Benchmark, you will find challenging work, a high level of trust, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work alongside pragmatic colleagues in an informal culture, supported by attractive employment conditions that enable long-term success. 

In addition, we offer: 

  • A competitive salary of up to €9,000 gross per month, based on full-time employment, depending on your experience, expertise, and background. 

  • revenue-based quarterly bonus scheme with a maximum payout of 5% of your quarterly salary.  

  • Enjoy 40 days of paid leave per year (27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV days). 

  • Personal growth and development, with a tailored development path that aligns with your ambitions and the needs of the business. 

  • Flexibility in how you organize your workweek, enabling you to balance work and personal life in a way that works for you. 

  • A strong engineering-driven knowledge culture, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation are central. Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn Sessions and Pitch Discovery Sessions, you will have ample opportunities to learn, inspire others, and develop new ideas. 

 

Who are you?

Whether you're already leading large-scale engineering programs or ready to take on a broader strategic role, you thrive in complex, technology-driven environments. You know how to align stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and guide multidisciplinary teams towards a common goal. With your leadership skills, business acumen and ability to bring structure to complexity, you successfully translate ambitious plans into tangible results.  

 

Furthermore, we are looking for: 

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering.  

  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary teams around common goals and priorities.  

  • Proven track record in delivering complex systems and development programs, from concept and design through industrialization and customer delivery.  

  • Strong technical affinity, capable of translating engineering challenges into clear plans, decisions and results.  

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, combined with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced international environment and willingness to travel. 

 

If you're excited by the challenge of leading global semiconductor programs at the forefront of technology, we cannot wait to get in touch! 

 

Serious Tech 
At Benchmark, you work on products that make a real impact through innovation, whether by improving safety, enhancing healthcare, or making everyday life easier. From product design and engineering to volume production and, in some cases, direct delivery to end users, the entire process takes place at our Almelo facility, where you will work alongside approximately 650 colleagues. 

 

We develop and manufacture innovative solutions for industries including semiconductor, healthcare, aerospace, and industrial markets. From concept to production, the complete product lifecycle comes together under one roof. While the technical challenges are significant, our culture remains down-to-earth and approachable. You will work with people who take ownership, support one another, and continuously strive for improvement. 

 

Seriously you? 

We are looking for people who are energized by complex technology and are motivated by challenging work. People who take initiative, share ideas, and enjoy working together to make things better every day. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

We do not appreciate unsolicited acquisition. No rights or obligations can be derived from the unsolicited submission of candidates by agencies or third parties without prior written approval from HR.

title: ad/mbo-stage Informatiebeheer, Documenten Ordenen & Kwaliteitszorg
description:
ad/mbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos?
Krijg je energie van uitzoeken, structureren en dingen overzichtelijk maken?
Werk je graag met digitale systemen?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen.

Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten:

  • Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen.

  • Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan.

  • Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid.

  • Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten.

  • Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen

Je loopt stage bij het team Staf van Dataverzameling (DVZ) van het CBS in Heerlen. Vanuit deze directie wordt een groot deel van de data verzameld die het CBS nodig heeft voor zijn werk. Je krijgt dus een kijkje achter de schermen bij een organisatie die dagelijks met veel verschillende soorten data werkt.
Jouw stageopdracht gaat over kwaliteitszorg voor alle teams binnen DVZ.

Je staat er tijdens je stage natuurlijk niet alleen voor: je hebt collega’s om je heen bij wie je terechtkunt met vragen en ideeën. De sfeer op de afdeling is informeel en gezellig. Collega’s zijn makkelijk aanspreekbaar en helpen elkaar graag. Natuurlijk wordt er hard gewerkt, maar er is ook tijd voor een praatje bij de koffieautomaat of een gezamenlijke lunch. Als je wilt, kun je tijdens de lunch ook aansluiten bij een lunchwandeling.
Kortom: je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen, nieuwe dingen te leren en echt mee te werken in een team.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een ad- of mbo-opleiding informatiebeheer, administratie, business services of management support.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Het werken met documenten en informatie en deze op een overzichtelijke manier ordenen.

  • Het werken met digitale programma’s en systemen en het snel wegwijs worden in nieuwe systemen.

  • Nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werken en het leuk vinden om dingen netjes en overzichtelijk te maken.

  • Samenwerken en overleggen met collega’s, vragen stellen en meedenken over hoe iets beter of makkelijker kan.

Je werkt graag netjes en gestructureerd, bent betrouwbaar en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te leren. Je pakt uit jezelf dingen op, denkt mee en stelt vragen als iets niet duidelijk is. Ook vind je het prettig om samen te werken en makkelijk contact te maken met collega’s.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • praktijkervaring opdoet met document- en informatiebeheer en leert hoe je informatie overzichtelijk en goed vindbaar maakt;

  • zelfstandig aan de slag gaat, maar ook samenwerkt en overlegt met collega’s;

  • leert hoe je duidelijk communiceert, vragen stelt en goed afstemt met je stagebegeleider;

  • leert om problemen en verbeterpunten op tijd te herkennen en deze samen met je collega’s te bespreken;

  • feedback krijgt en en toepast, zodat je tijdens je stage steeds meer leert en groeit in je werkzaamheden.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.

Samen met 13 collega's werk je aan het dagelijks operationeel houden en verder ontwikkelen van onze technische IT-dienstverlening.

Een belangrijke ontwikkeling is de verdere uitbreiding van selfservice, onder andere door de inzet van Infrastructure as Code en het via API's ontsluiten van onze diensten. Daarbij staan veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie centraal. Onze diensten voldoen vanaf het ontwerp aan de geldende CIS- en ISO-kaders, waarbij het naleven van security- en compliancebeleid prioriteit heeft.

Je begeleidt een team van 10 tot 15 engineers en senior engineers bij Agile werken en de inhoudelijke productontwikkeling. Je stimuleert een proactieve werkwijze en zorgt voor de verbinding tussen strategische doelstellingen en de dagelijkse uitvoering. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega-productmanagers, architecten, servicemanagers, beheerteams en andere stakeholders.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Je ontwikkelt een samenhangende productstrategie en visie voor de productsuite van het team Data en Webdiensten en stemt deze af met het hoofd IGI en andere stakeholders. Hierin borg je naast vernieuwing ook veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie.

  • Je vertaalt de vastgestelde productstrategie en visie naar een meerjarige roadmap, kwartaalplanningen en een productbacklog.

  • Je organiseert en begeleidt Agile-events, waaronder dagstarts, sprintplanningen, sprintreviews, retrospectives en refinements, zowel binnen als buiten het eigen team. Daarnaast coach je teamleden.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor technische teams, architecten, Security Services, Contracts & Finance en servicemanagement. Je bevordert de samenwerking en zorgt voor afstemming over productdoelen en -strategieën.

  • Je onderhoudt contact met afnemers en andere productmanagers, verzamelt feedback en vertaalt hun uitdagingen en behoeften naar de verdere productontwikkeling.

  • Je ontwikkelt samen met het hoofd IGI en andere productmanagers KPI's en succesmaatstaven, bijvoorbeeld voor adoptie, efficiëntie, kosten en productiviteit van engineers. Je maakt de prestaties van geleverde diensten inzichtelijk en houdt toezicht op veiligheid, compliance, beschikbaarheid en performance. Hiervoor benut je bestaande inzichten vanuit servicemanagement en ontwikkel je waar nodig aanvullende inzichten.


Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het team Data en Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). Deze afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 experts, verdeeld over onze locaties in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het team Data en Webdiensten telt circa 15 collega's die eveneens op beide locaties werkzaam zijn.

We werken volgens een Agile-methodiek in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage aan deze werkwijze vinden we belangrijk. Dit betekent onder andere het opstellen van kwalitatief goede stories en epics, het actueel houden van stories op het Azure DevOps-bord en een actieve, constructieve deelname aan dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Samenwerking, continu verbeteren en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk. Dit is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.


Dit ben jij

Je bent een initiatiefrijke, ondernemende en zelfstandige productmanager die strategisch inzicht weet te combineren met technische basiskennis. Je begrijpt de technische uitdagingen van onze infrastructuurdiensten en kunt hierover effectief communiceren met zowel engineers als andere stakeholders.

Je beschikt over methodische kennis van Agile en Scrum en weet hoe je samenwerking en continue verbetering binnen een team stimuleert. Je kunt strategisch denken, relevante markttrends herkennen en deze vertalen naar een productvisie. Daarbij weet je verschillende belangen en behoeften met elkaar te verbinden.

Je hebt een sterke ambitie om de user- en customer experience maximaal te faciliteren. Continu samen verbeteren zit in jouw DNA. Je ziet kansen om onze dienstverlening verder te ontwikkelen en neemt initiatief om verbeteringen daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Daarbij herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beschikt over technische basiskennis en hebt begrip van API's, cloudsystemen en software- en/of infrastructuurarchitectuur.

  • Je hebt kennis van Agile en Scrum en beschikt over de methodische vaardigheden om deze werkwijzen toe te passen.

  • Je beschikt over sterke sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden om effectief samen te werken met engineers en stakeholders.

  • Je bent in staat om strategisch te denken en markttrends te vertalen naar een duidelijke productvisie.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en ondernemend, neemt initiatief en stimuleert een proactieve manier van werken.

  • Je bent gericht op continu samen verbeteren en hebt oog voor de behoeften en ervaringen van gebruikers en afnemers.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

title: Senior Databasebeheerder (deeltijd 16 uur)
description:

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Senior Database Specialist versterk je ons team met specialistische kennis van Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL. Je richt je vooral op complexe technische vraagstukken, verbeteringen en vernieuwing. De dagelijkse operatie ligt bij het team; jij helpt juist daar waar extra expertise, verdieping of richting nodig is.

Onze databasediensten vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van de technische infrastructuur van het CBS. Beschikbaarheid, performance, veiligheid en continuïteit zijn daarbij essentieel. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkelen we onze dienstverlening verder door meer te automatiseren, nieuwe databaseservices te onderzoeken en onze infrastructuur verder te moderniseren.

Met jouw ervaring help je het team bij vraagstukken die verder gaan dan het dagelijkse beheer. Je analyseert complexe problemen, adviseert over technische keuzes en helpt structurele verbeteringen te realiseren. Daarbij werk je zowel met onze bestaande MSSQL- en PostgreSQL-omgevingen als aan de ontwikkeling van toekomstige databasediensten.

Omdat je 16 uur per week werkt, ligt de nadruk op werkzaamheden waarvoor jouw senior expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt:

  • adviseren over databasearchitectuur, high availability, disaster recovery, lifecycle management en de verwerking van grote hoeveelheden data;

  • initiëren en uitvoeren van structurele technische verbeteringen en bijdragen aan upgrades, migraties en automatisering van databasewerkzaamheden;

  • bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe databasediensten, waaronder Database as a Service en toekomstige technologieën zoals graphdatabases;

  • meedenken over de verdere modernisering van het platform, waaronder containerisatie, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code en CI/CD;

  • verbeteren van monitoring, logging, capaciteitsbeheer, back-up- en restorevoorzieningen, encryptie, autorisaties en informatiebeveiliging en jouw kennis delen met collega’s en andere technische specialisten.


Je toekomstige collega's

Binnen het team werken we Agile in combinatie met ITIL. We gebruiken Azure DevOps om het werk inzichtelijk te maken en werken met stories en epics. Ook nemen we deel aan vaste momenten zoals dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Met 16 uur per week maak je volwaardig onderdeel uit van het team, maar verwachten we niet dat je iedere operationele taak oppakt. In overleg bepalen we waar jouw expertise het meeste verschil kan maken. Je werkt daardoor nauw samen met de collega’s die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor de databasediensten en ondersteunt hen bij complexere technische vraagstukken en ontwikkelingen.
We werken met collega’s op verschillende locaties en vanuit verschillende specialismen. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk.

Je bent een ervaren databasespecialist die snel tot de kern van een technisch vraagstuk komt. Je hoeft niet voortdurend bij de dagelijkse operatie betrokken te zijn om te begrijpen wat er speelt en bent in staat om binnen je beschikbare tijd duidelijke prioriteiten te stellen.

Je combineert diepgaande databasekennis met een bredere blik op infrastructuur, automatisering en security. Je denkt niet alleen in tijdelijke oplossingen, maar zoekt naar structurele verbeteringen die ook op langere termijn waarde toevoegen.

title: Mid Market Account Executive - Benelux
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. We are seeking account managers to oversee deal sizes ranging from €10k to €300k across a comprehensive suite of 15+ product solutions, engaging key decision-makers including Finance Directors and Managing Directors. Joining our team offers the autonomy and support to tackle challenging objectives and drive impactful results.

While this position offers remote flexibility across the Netherlands, periodic travel to meet clients on-site is expected (typically bi-weekly).

You should apply if:

  • You want to help define the future of physical operations: Your contributions will directly enable real-world impact—supporting critical infrastructure, streamlining supply chains, and advancing workforce safety.
  • You prioritize continuous prospecting: Physical operations encompass wide-ranging sectors where contacts are often mobile. Top sales reps actively identify prospective organizations and build meaningful pipeline connection points.
  • You possess deep curiosity about diverse business models: You will explore various physical sectors, from field services to manufacturing and food distribution, striving to understand operational details at scale.
  • You are committed to continuous learning: Navigating our cloud platform involves mastering new operational domains and solutions, requiring dedicated focus to achieve long-term growth.
  • You foster authentic long-term partnerships: Many target organizations are transitioning from legacy methods to modern cloud technology. Earning long-term trust is core to helping them digitally transform.
  • You thrive on high-performing teams: Working at Samsara means being part of a team dedicated to excellence and pushing boundaries as we build for the future.

In this role you will:

  • Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.
  • Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.
  • Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Sales background: Minimum. 18 months closing experience within a proactive SaaS outreach model, demonstrating independent PG/pipeline generation.
  • Consistent quota achievement: Demonstrated performance exceeding targets within complex technology environments.
  • Complex deal navigation: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder evaluations and technical proofs-of-concept effectively.
  • Language proficiency: Native-level fluency in Dutch.

Advantageous:

  • Operational interest: Eagerness to discover how physical operations function across sectors to better address customer needs.
  • Structured methodology: A disciplined sales practice focused on consistent activity execution to produce predictable results.
  • Analytical focus: A data-informed mindset toward managing pipeline volume, discovery quality, and multi-threading for accurate forecasting.
  • Adaptability and growth: A proactive focus on continuous learning, incorporating feedback, and refining tactics over time.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
€132.000—€132.000 EUR

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

title: Accounts Payable & Financial Controller
description:
Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het nemen van beslissingen binnen Crisp. Je combineert de dagelijkse sturing op de crediteurenadministratie met uitdagende controlewerkzaamheden, data-analyses en het automatiseren van onze processen met behulp van moderne tools en AI.

Wat je gaat doen

Je werkt elke dag met een gezellig team vol gedreven mensen. We hebben ervaring in business control, accounting, corporate finance, data analytics, fiscaal recht en auditing. Crisp groeit snel, en de verantwoordelijkheden van ons team dus ook. Zo is geen dag hetzelfde en blijven we onszelf continu ontwikkelen. We sparren veel en staan open voor elkaars mening.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken en controleren van inkomende facturen en declaraties. Je staat leveranciers te woord, beheert de mailstroom en zet betalingen klaar.

  • Je stuurt een team van werkstudenten en stagiaires aan en zorgt er samen met hen voor dat alle facturen tijdig en correct worden verwerkt.

  • Je denkt actief mee over het slim inrichten van financiële workflows. Je verkent en implementeert mogelijkheden voor procesautomatisering, slimme datakoppelingen en AI-oplossingen (zoals OCR-herkenning en geautomatiseerde factuurverwerking).

  • Je rapporteert aan de Lead Financial Controller, die je ondersteunt in je dagelijkse werkzaamheden en je helpt om door te groeien in je rol.

Dit ben jij

Als ideale kandidaat heb je al een basis aan kennis en ervaring en wil je blijven leren in een vakgebied dat continu verandert en digitaliseert. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy).

  • Je hebt 0-3 jaar relevante werkervaring in een financiële of control-functie.

  • Kennis van accountingsoftware (zoals Exact) is een pré.

  • Je bent handig met data en hebt een sterke affiniteit met automatisering en nieuwe technologieën (zoals AI-tools, data-integraties en procesoptimalisatie).

  • Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

  • Je bent integer, nauwkeurig en risicobewust. Je begrijpt dat een strakke administratie de basis vormt voor goede besluitvorming.

  • Je denkt in kansen en mogelijkheden: je ziet direct waar processen sneller, slimmer of foutlozer kunnen en schroomt niet om dit op te pakken.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

title: Audit Methodology Lead
description:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you'll own

  • Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform

  • Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against

  • Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one

  • Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review

  • Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix

  • Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements

  • Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes

  • Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product

  • Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ

  • Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it

What you'll bring

  • A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent

  • Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions

  • Recent experience across several clients and industries

  • Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work

  • Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail

  • Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write

  • Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion

Nice to have:

  • You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review

  • You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today

  • You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process

Hi, I'm Killian, VP Engineering at FeedbackFruits. 👋

We're moving to one Engineering Manager per squad, and we’re looking for an Engineering Manager for our System Squad. It's our most product-heavy squad: five engineers, three senior and two medior, building the learning tools that teachers and students around the world use every day. Because so much of the squad's work is shaped by what those users need, whoever leads it works closely with the Product Manager on what we build as well as on how we build it.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager with engineering depth, someone senior engineers respect on code and architecture, who has chosen to focus on growing people and still cares a lot about the product. You'd own how the squad works, set its technical standards and lead the way in how it uses AI, and you'd help raise the bar across the wider engineering department too. Our stack is Ruby on Rails and Ember.js, and experience with either is welcome but not required.

What you'll do:

  • Co-own the backlog and roadmap with the Product Manager: challenge scope on user value, propose smaller first versions and turn product goals into technical plans

  • Lead the squad's day-to-day delivery, from planning to unblocking, so engineers keep shipping

  • Grow every engineer through regular 1:1s, direct feedback and a personal growth path in our Career Progression Framework, with a development plan for each of them every year

  • Set the squad's technical direction and quality standards, and review code and architecture with enough depth to be genuinely useful while the team does the coding

  • Use AI in your own work with good judgement, set the example for the squad and help everyone adopt it while keeping quality and security high

  • Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product, Design and stakeholders, including what the option you didn't pick would cost

  • Review delivery and reliability with the squad every week (DORA metrics, PR cycle time, uptime, incidents), balance roadmap work against tech debt, and take your turn in the on-call rotation

  • Help hire the people who join the squad, and help shape how the engineering department works beyond it

What you bring:

  • You have 6+ years in software engineering, with at least 2 of them managing engineers with direct reports

  • Your engineering background is senior-level, so you hold your own on code and architecture in a web stack

  • You're curious about users and why the squad builds what it builds. You've shaped a roadmap together with a PM and changed what got built because of something you learned from users or data

  • You've grown engineers to the next level and can point to the conversations, including the hard ones, that got them there

  • You balance empathy with directness: you build strong relationships and still say the hard thing. You stay steady under pressure and can hold an unpopular position when it matters

  • AI is already part of how you work, and you have a clear view on how to bring it into a team

  • You see skill gaps as teachable, in yourself and in every engineer, and you ask for feedback as readily as you give it

  • You get energy from a scale-up, even when it feels like building the plane while flying it, and you're comfortable with uncertainty and change

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails or Ember.js, EdTech or B2B SaaS used at scale, a tech-lead or product-engineer background, or setting up DORA/DX metrics and CI/CD all help, as does an affinity with education

  • Excellent written and spoken English, available full-time

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation: €90K – €105K

  • • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. Your offer within this range depends on your experience and interview performance: €90K – €105K

title: Product Manager
description:
Hi, I'm Maria, Interim VP Product at FeedbackFruits. 👋

FeedbackFruits is moving from a founder-led company to a product-led one, which means Product is taking on a much bigger role in deciding what we build and why. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it.

I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. That means helping instructors see which students are stuck while there's still time to step in, making grading faster and less painful, and making it easy for a great activity to travel from one teacher to the next across an institution. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself.

The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. You’ll also help shape how product works here as we raise the bar together: how we find the right problems, make calls and bring people along, and what great looks like for the PMs who join after you.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for your squad, and keep its work tied to what matters most to us right now: teachers getting value from FeedbackFruits early and coming back for more

  • Run discovery with teachers, institutions and partners, dig into the data, and frame each problem clearly before anyone starts designing a solution

  • Make the prioritisation calls, including the "not now"s, and explain them with enough context that people follow your reasoning even when they'd have chosen differently

  • Work side by side with engineers on technical approach and feasibility, and with designers on critiques and validating solutions with users

  • Write specs and acceptance criteria clear enough that the squad can move without waiting on you, then review what gets built and keep iterating

  • Define MVPs that get something useful into teachers' hands quickly, and after launch, look at the results and decide whether to scale it, rework it or retire it

  • Keep Sales, Partner Success and leadership aligned by documenting decisions, presenting strategy and progress, and keeping the roadmap visible

  • Help the squad see how its work lands with teachers and students, and make time to celebrate the wins

What you bring:

  • You have 3+ years of product management experience, and you've shipped B2B SaaS features that measurably changed how people use a product

  • You spot opportunities before anyone asks for them, and you'd rather spend an extra day understanding a problem than a month building the wrong solution

  • You can say "no" to a request and keep the relationship intact, because you back your reasoning with data and strategy

  • You write and speak with the kind of clarity that saves everyone a follow-up meeting. Your expectations are set before the work starts, and your feedback is direct

  • You understand how products are built technically, well enough to have a proper conversation with engineers about trade-offs. A technical or design background helps a lot here

  • You think big and ship small, and you know when to fight for quality and when "good enough for now" is the right call

  • You ask for feedback, take it without getting defensive, and change course when the evidence points somewhere new

  • You already use AI tools in your day-to-day work for research synthesis, analysis and documentation, and you're curious about where they can take the craft next

  • Experience in edtech, with LMS platforms like Canvas, Brightspace, Moodle or Blackboard, or with integrations and APIs gives you a head start

  • Available 40 hours per week, with 3 days a week from our Amsterdam office

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite)

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation: €83K – €90K

  • • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. Your offer within this range depends on your experience and interview performance: €83K – €90K

title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
description:
We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits.

  • We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform.

  • Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers.

  • We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable.

  • Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker.

  • Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery.

  • We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output.

What you'll do:

  • Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to

  • Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before

  • Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. The balance will depend on which squad you join, but keeping the codebase healthy and customers unblocked is part of the job

  • Contribute to improving our CI/CD practices and deployment pipeline as we work toward more frequent, more reliable releases

  • Keep performance in mind across the stack

  • Build and maintain integrations with Learning Management Systems using LTI and partner APIs

  • Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, bringing both quality standards and a pragmatist's sense of what's worth the effort

What you bring:

  • You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and Ruby on Rails is your home stack: you've shipped production code with it, you know its conventions, and you're comfortable in its edges

  • You write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought. RSpec and Capybara are part of your regular toolkit, and you write tests that actually catch things rather than just confirm the happy path

  • You are user-oriented: when you're deciding how a feature should work, your first instinct is to think about the person using it, not the implementation that's most convenient

  • You've worked in a legacy codebase before and come through it well. You know what to fix, what to leave, and how to leave things better than you found them without getting stuck in a refactoring spiral

  • You understand CI/CD well enough to work within good practices and to nudge a codebase toward them when they're missing

  • You communicate clearly, give honest feedback in code reviews, and take it just as well. You’re collaborative without needing everyone to agree with you

  • You are pragmatic and document your decisions; you'd rather make a thoughtful trade-off and write it down than chase the perfect solution indefinitely

  • Familiarity with Ember.js or migration scenarios from it to Hotwire is a genuine advantage here; experience with AI dev tooling, Azure, or observability practices would serve you well too

What you get:

  • Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite)

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation: €60K – €75K

  • • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. Your offer within this range depends on your experience and interview performance: €60K – €75K

title: Financial Administrator
description:
Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋

Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it.

I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it.

We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it.

What you'll do:

  • Send out sales invoices on time. This includes setting up new customers and uploading invoices to procurement portals such as Ariba and PaymentWorks

  • Set up and maintain customer subscriptions in the ERP system based on signed contracts, and create invoices and credit notes for all legal entities

  • Keep track of unpaid invoices, send payment reminders to institutions that haven’t paid, and flag invoices that stay unpaid

  • Partner with Sales and Partner Success to address billing and payment queries

  • Ensure supplier invoices and expenses are processed on time

  • Prepare the weekly payment run for approval

  • Compare bank transactions with our accounting records and resolve any discrepancies

  • Manage the Finance mailbox: customer invoice and payment questions, supplier requests, supplier onboarding forms, and internal requests that come in through the ticketing system

  • Support month-end close and annual accounts

  • Write down how finance processes work in the Finance database in Notion, and update it when you improve them

What you bring:

  • You stay accurate and organised during busy periods. At month-end you keep daily work running smoothly while closing the month.

  • You follow things through to the end, in a friendly way. Late payments, missing details or an invoice that needs to match a contract: you stay on it until it’s sorted, and people enjoy working with you.

  • You take ownership of your work from start to finish. You plan your own week, set your own priorities and keep things moving.

  • You speak up when something in the numbers looks off, so we can fix it together.

  • You enjoy working with tools and software, and like finding new ways to get more out of them.

  • You’re comfortable building things as you go. You ask good questions, fill in the gaps and make sure you know the next steps before you start.

  • You have at least one year of experience in a finance or similar administrative role (two or more is a plus), including hands-on work with billing or subscriptions. We care more about your experience than your degree.

  • You’ve worked with an accounting system or ERP, such as Exact Online, NetSuite, Dynamics or SAP. Experience with Exact Online, Moss or procurement portals is a bonus

  • You write and speak English fluently, as we use it for all internal and external work.

  • You’re available 24 to 32 hours per week and can work from our Amsterdam office 2-3 days a week.

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year, based on a 40-hour work week

  • Hybrid work schedule (2-3 days onsite)

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We're looking for a sharp, curious, and impact-driven Product Analyst to help us build products our customers love. You'll join the Product Analytics team at Manychat, working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to bring data into every decision we make.This role is perfect for someone who loves turning data into quick action: zooming in to uncover the signal in the noise, and zooming out to see the big picture. If you thrive at the intersection of product thinking and data, excited about working in a fast-scaling SaaS product, and want to have a positive impact on the daily lives of more than one million creators, influencers, and brands, we'd love to meet you.

WHAT YOUʼLL DO 🚀

  • Drive insights that matter: Translate complex data into compelling stories that guide product decisions and strategy.

  • Shape success metrics and influence the roadmap: Partner with PMs to define KPIs, metric trees, and measurable goals that connect product impact to business outcomes. Surface insights that size opportunities, highlight trade-offs, and sharpen prioritization.

  • Guide experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests.

  • Build trusted data: Collaborate with engineers and data teams to ensure reliable, scalable data models and tracking.

  • Make data accessible: Create dashboards, enable self-service, and drive data literacy across product teams.

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE 💥

  • Experience: 4+ years in product analytics or similar area, ideally in SaaS or consumer-facing products.

  • Technical skills: Strong SQL and Python for data analysis; proficiency with BI tools (e.g. Tableau) is expected.

  • Metric trees & product mindset: Comfortable building and working with metric trees, and translating data into hypotheses, opportunities, and product decisions.

  • Experimentation (a plus): Familiarity with A/B testing and experimental design is a bonus.

  • Stats comfort: Solid grasp of statistics and how to separate signal from noise.

  • Communication & confidence: Clear and compelling storytelling – you can influence PMs, engineers, and leaders alike. Comfortable challenging assumptions and pushing back on stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

  • AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to speed up analysis, generate hypotheses, write/debug SQL and Python, and streamline reporting.

  • Ways of working: Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to drive initiatives independently.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗
Important: We are NOT offering relocations for this position.

Here’s how we care about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • Annual professional development reimbursement.

  • Generous time-off policy to balance your work and life.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Hybrid format to split your time between the comforts of home and collaborative spaces.

  • Relocation support for you and your family.

  • Professional development budget for relevant conference tickets, training programs, or courses.

  • Free meals and snacks in the office.

title: Head of People Operations
description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.

Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.

This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

  • You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance

  • You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it

  • You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well

  • AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and think in systems. You have the operational depth to manage complex multi-country employment realities, and the leadership to develop hub teams that genuinely own their work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

Lead the Hub Model

  • Own People Operations across all hubs: Netherlands, Spain, Armenia, US (Austin, Bay Area, New York), Brazil, Remote

  • Each hub team covers the full employee lifecycle in location — pre-boarding, onboarding, changes, exits — with local office and facilities support, and local events and team-building

  • Set the standard for what excellent hub execution looks like, and hold it across all locations

  • Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

  • Build the hub community: connect People Ops partners across locations to share practice and raise the floor

Own Outcomes, Not Process

  • Hub teams should decide and act — your job is to remove blockers, not add approval layers

  • Own the OKR cascade: every hub has OKRs that roll up through the function; you're accountable for making that cascade real, not formal

  • Define what success looks like in each location — local service standards, local processes, local roadmap

Partner with Domain Leads

Clear interfaces are the model, not the exception:

  • Workplace & Experience — deploy global programs and standards locally; coordinate on facilities, office improvements, and events beyond the local scope

  • Payroll — ensure multi-country payroll accuracy and surface local issues early

  • People Tech — maintain HRIS data quality and drive system adoption across hubs

  • Compliance — support policy adoption, manager training, and exit case handling in every location

  • Rewards — run compensation reviews and benefits implementation per country

Challenge feasibility, propose alternatives, execute agreed decisions.

Build the Team

  • Manage People Operations Partners across locations: NL, ES, AM, BR, US, Remote

  • You're standing up the hub model while running it — build the team while it's operating

  • Drive team development: upgrade skills, address underperformance, enable people with AI tools

  • Build hub teams that operate autonomously — no daily hand-holding required

Manage the Operational Realities

  • Visa and relocation support coordination across locations

  • Local compliance and employment framework adherence, in partnership with Compliance

  • Office and facilities baseline across hub locations — in coordination with Workplace & Experience on standards

Build AI-Native Operations

  • Default to automation for employee queries, document generation, onboarding workflows, and operational logistics

  • Build self-service so people don't need to contact us for anything a good system can answer

  • Treat AI adoption within the function as infrastructure and a performance metric

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • Hub teams operating autonomously across all locations — you're steering, not executing day-to-day

  • Every hub has OKRs, knows what winning looks like, and can tell if they hit it

  • Employee lifecycle is consistent and increasingly automated across all locations

  • Cross-functional interfaces with Payroll, Tech, Compliance, W&E are clean and frictionless

  • Knowledge base live and current in a single source of truth

  • AI and automation handle the majority of repeatable operational tasks inside the function

  • Every hub partner owns their roadmap — not just their to-do list

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

Experience & Background

  • 10+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or Operations leadership in multinational environments

  • Direct experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries and employment frameworks

  • Proven record building distributed operating models — not just inheriting and running existing ones

  • Experience standing up new processes and functions in fast-changing environments

  • Strong change management experience — organizational transitions handled with operational rigor and human care

  • Experience in fast-scaling tech environments — SaaS and start-up / scale-up required

Skills & Mindset

  • Systems thinker: you see how processes connect, where the friction is, and what the fix is

  • AI-native operating instinct: you treat every new process as a question of which system or agent should own it

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: non-linear situations with predictable outcomes

  • Stakeholder management: you go and solve, not email and wait

  • Cross-cultural judgment: you understand employment realities across NL, ES, BR, AM, US — or learn fast when you don't

  • Executive presence: you partner with senior leadership and personally own the hardest operational calls

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

Benefits at Manychat don't start with a spreadsheet — they start with a belief: that you should be healthy, able to care for the people you love, and set up to do your best work. Everything below follows from that:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: instead of a fixed set of perks, you get a flexible benefits budget you can direct across the things that matter most — health, wellbeing, family, and your home office among them. Within these areas, the choice is yours.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota

  • 🌎 Work from where you need to — agreed with your team, not tied to a desk. Flexibility we built in on purpose, because location shouldn't get in the way of great work.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events

description:
Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel

Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak?

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is

Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen.

Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is.

Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen.

Wat maakt deze functie anders?

Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat.

Je kunt rekenen op:

· Premium hooroplossingen

· Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant

· Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek

· Warme leads via onze partner Audibene

· Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie

· Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap

· De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak

· Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé

Voor wie is dit een mooie stap?

Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren.

Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen.

Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je.

Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes.

En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past.

Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen?

Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

About MotherDuck

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do

The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.

  • Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.

  • Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.

  • Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.

  • Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.

  • Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most.

  • Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems.

  • Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team.

  • Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next.

What you bring

  • You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like.

  • You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.)

  • A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques.

  • Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at.

  • You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems.

  • You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies.

  • You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs.

  • You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment.

  • You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs.

What we provide

  • The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases.

  • Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.

  • Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.

  • A good pension plan

  • Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong.

  • Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. We have to warn you though, most of us like the office so much we come anyway. It’s on the river Ij, with a great lunch every day.



Please Apply
